effects_provenance.raw: Applescotti THCA Flower Essential / 28g Strain Profile Applescotti THCA Flower is an elegant hybrid created through crossing Apple Fritter with Biscotti, originally bred by the renowned Cookies Fam. The cultivar combines fresh notes of juicy green apples, warm spice, and sweet almond cookies into a uniquely indulgent aromatic profile, with dense, frost-coated buds that hold the layered character throughout. Effects Applescotti delivers a balanced experience that pairs warm cerebral euphoria with a comfortable body baseline. The high feels well-rounded and pleasant — suitable for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of steady plateau that makes this cultivar broadly appealing. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: crisp green apple up front, with warm spice through the middle and a sweet almond-cookie finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably bakery-rich. The terpene profile reads apple-spice-and-cookie — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Applescotti harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Applescotti THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Applescotti THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. effects_provenance.raw: Blue Zushi THCA Flower Essential / 28g (Smalls) Strain Profile Blue Zushi THCA Flower is a hybrid bred from Zkittlez and Kush Mints . The cross brings the colorful, fruit-forward bag appeal Zkittlez is famous for and pairs it with the cool, earthy depth of Kush Mints — producing buds with deep purple-blue expression and a layered terpene profile dominated by limonene and caryophyllene . Effects Blue Zushi delivers a balanced euphoric experience that settles into a comfortable, body-relaxing baseline. The high feels mood-lifting without being racy, and physically calming without being sedating — making it a popular pick among users seeking steady stress relief or a reliable evening unwind. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: ripe blueberry and tropical fruit up front, with a cool minty middle and a sweet, slightly creamy finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and dessert-leaning. The terpene profile is limonene-forward with a peppery caryophyllene backbone — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Blue Zushi harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Blue Zushi THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Blue Zushi THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. Dense, sticky flowers are heavily coated in trichomes, living up to the resinous reputation that made GG4 a modern classic. The aroma is loud with diesel, earthy pine, and sour funk, backed by subtle chocolate and coffee notes. Flavor follows with rich gas and Chem funk, finishing with a slightly sweet, earthy character. Powerful, euphoric, and deeply relaxing, GG4 delivers the heavy-hitting character that has kept this cultivar in rotation for more than a decade. effects_provenance.raw: Cherry Ice THCA Flower Essential / 28g (Smalls) Strain Profile Cherry Ice THCA Flower is a refreshing hybrid that blends sweet fruit and cool, herbal undertones for a clean, flavorful experience. The cultivar produces dense, well-structured buds with an aromatic profile bursting with juicy cherries, red berries, and a hint of minty freshness layered over a light earthy base. Effects Cherry Ice delivers a balanced experience that pairs uplifting cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels well-rounded and pleasant — suitable for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of refreshing character that distinguishes cherry-mint hybrids. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: smooth cherry up front, with red berry through the middle and a cool minty finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably refreshing. The terpene profile reads cherry-and-mint — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Cherry Ice harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Cherry Ice THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Cherry Ice THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains.
